EDEN Support-kit module

One module per Doc. Fill in the table, write the module, then move this Doc into the ready folder. You never need GitHub or Markdown.

# How it works

1. Make your own copy: File \> Make a copy. Name it after your module.  
2. Fill in the table under Module metadata. Pick from the dropdowns where there is one; elsewhere replace the text in \[square brackets\]. Leave a row on its placeholder if it does not apply.  
3. Write under Module content. Keep the headings as Google Docs headings and lists as real bullets. Comment and suggest with colleagues as usual.  
4. When it is ready, move this Doc into the folder [EDEN Support-kit – ready for the kit](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qTIuQq-G62Bf6-CZgTxH-C4KevIcWnGI).  
5. Within the hour you get a comment here: the link to the review, and anything the reviewers will check. Keep editing this Doc; your changes update the review automatically.

# Module metadata

| Field | Value | How to fill it |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Title | \[Module name\] | Task first, under 8 words. Example: Preparing deposits |
| Description | \[One sentence\] | Shown on cards and in search results. |
| Role | \[choose a role\] | Who the module is for. |
| I want to | \[what the reader wants to do\] | The user story, lower case. Example: prepare my files for deposit, with sustainable formats and basic checks |
| So that | \[why it matters to them\] | The benefit; say something the title does not. |
| Short task | \[a few words\] | Under 45 characters, for the home page “I want to…” menu. Example: prepare my files for deposit |
| Kind of help | \[choose a kind\] | What the reader gets from it. |
| Order in the role path | \[1\] | Where it sits among this role’s modules. |
| Main process 1 | \[choose a process\] | The WP1 Core Preservation Processes this module mainly teaches: one to three. [WP1 list](https://eosc-eden.github.io/wp1-cpp-descriptions/) |
| Main process 2 | \[choose a process\] | Optional. |
| Main process 3 | \[choose a process\] | Optional. |
| Other processes it applies | \[names or numbers, comma-separated\] | Processes the reader also touches. Names work: “integrity checking, replication”. |
| Frameworks cited | \[e.g. CoreTrustSeal R14; nestor\] | Separate frameworks with semicolons. Known: CoreTrustSeal 2026 or 2023, nestor, ISO 16363, OAIS, PREMIS, EOSC FAIR metrics. |
| Disciplines | all | Comma-separated, or all. |
| Data types | all | Comma-separated, or all. |
| Keywords | \[a few words for search\] | Comma-separated. |
| Related modules | \[titles of related modules\] | Comma-separated titles of other kit modules. |
| Contributors | \[type @ and pick people\] | Names as in the kit’s contributor list; new names are added with their ORCID by the reviewers. |
| Status | Draft | Set to Ready for review when you move the Doc. |
